name: Roe crab and meat crab
summary: Cua gạch and cua thịt, roe crab and meat crab, are sold by the kilogram, with cua biển and cua bể on the same boards.
howToEat: Order it by weight. Island seafood is at its best in winter, before the spring spawn.
where: Đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc, the two seafood streets of Cát Bà town.
seoTitle: Cua gạch and cua thịt on Cat Ba
